name: TRAE Agent 窗口
desc: TRAE's agent-first workspace for dispatching coding and office agents
desc_zh: TRAE 里以智能体为中心的全局工作台
solves: IDE chats are tied to one open project. The Agent window runs several agents across projects and cloud machines, and keeps every artifact in one place.
solves_zh: IDE 对话只能围着当前项目转。Agent 窗口可跨项目并行调度多个智能体，产物统一归档。
best_for: Open it when a task spans repos, or a long job should keep running in the cloud.
best_for_zh: 手头的活跨了几个仓库，或者有个耗时任务想丢到云端接着跑，就开它。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://docs.trae.cn/llms.txt (official docs index), then https://docs.trae.）。 Not a new download: this is the new agent-centred window inside the existing TRAE desktop client (ledger record `trae`, trae.cn). It is the surface into which TraeWork was merged. Timeline from official docs: 2026-08 ~ 2026-10 the IDE was labelled TraeCode in the official changelog (docs.trae.ai headings 2026-08-20 and 2026-09-20); 2026-10-08 TRAE v3.4.0 shipped the Agent window (CN); the official notice TraeWork 与 TraeCode 已融合为全新的 TRAE was created 2026-10-09; 2026-10-15 TRAE v3.4.1~3.4.4 added one-click migration of TraeWork chat data with optional uninstall of TraeWork. Reviewer actions on existing records: (1) `traework` (ledger date 2026-01-01) should become status merged -> `trae`; its first public day was 2026-03-31 (see traework notes in report.md). (2) TraeCode was only a temporary name of the IDE and should be mentioned in `trae` notes, not filed as its own record. The international changelog (docs.trae.ai) dates the same Agent window to 2026-10-08 (TRAE v3.6.0). 首次公开日期来源：https://docs.trae.cn/ide_changelog
